description.text: Revised dosing to allow a faster infusion rate up to 5 mL/min and added overall survival data

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental biologics application provides for revisions to US Prescribing Information (USPI) Section 2 Dosage and Administration to allow a faster infusion rate for the administration of elotuzumab up to 5 mL/min based on data from CA204112, entitled “*A Phase 2 Single Arm Study of Safety of Elotuzumab Administered over Approximately 60 Minutes in Combination with Lenalidomide and Dexamethasone for Newly Diagnosed or Relapsed/Refractory Multiple Myeloma Patients.*” In addition, it provides revisions to USPI Section 14 Clinical Studies to add data for overall survival based on pre-planned interim analysis for study CA204004, entitled “*A Phase 3, Randomized, Open Label Trial of Lenalidomide/dexamethasone With or Without Elotuzumab in Relapsed or Refractory Multiple Myeloma.*”

description.text: Added new indication for Empliciti in combination with pomalidomide and dexamethasone for adults with multiple myeloma after at least two prior therapies including lenalidomide and a proteasome inhibitor

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental biologics application provides for a new indication for **Empliciti®** in combination with pomalidomide and dexamethasone for the treatment of adult patients with multiple myeloma who have received at least two prior therapies including lenalidomide and a proteasome inhibitor.

description.text: Labeling update to Section 14 Clinical Studies with final overall survival data from study CA204004 (elotuzumab with lenalidomide/dexamethasone in relapsed/refractory multiple myeloma); no new indication

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental biologics application provides for updates to the United States Prescribing Information Section 14 Clinical Studies with final overall survival (OS) data for study CA204004, entitled "A Phase 3, Randomized, Open Label Trial of Lenalidomide/dexamethasone With or Without Elotuzumab in Relapsed or Refractory Multiple Myeloma."

description.text: Labeling update adding final overall survival data from study CA204125 and updated serious adverse reaction rates; no new indication

citations.quote: This Prior Approval supplemental biologics license application provides for updates to the US Prescribing Information under Section 14, Clinical Studies, with the final overall survival data for study CA204125, titled "An Open Label, Randomized Phase 2 Trial of Pomalidomide/Dexamethasone With or Without Elotuzumab in Relapsed and Refractory Multiple Myeloma", and updates to Section 6, Adverse Reactions, with updated rates for serious adverse reactions.
